text: To address these limitations, we propose a robust method for accurately estimating the number of active sources in the brain using the F-ratio statistical approach. Our method introduces formal decision criteria that sequentially increase the number of sources in the multiple dipole localization problem until all sources are found. Our method is based on the F-ratio test, which is commonly used in statistics to compare the variances of two samples. It is sensitive to differences in the variances of the samples and can be used to determine whether adding a source to the model significantly improves the fit of the model to the data. The F-ratio statistical approach allows for a comparison between a full model with a higher number of sources and a reduced model with fewer sources.
source_label: An F-ratio-based method for estimating the number of active sources in MEG
